brief:
Israeli attacks killed eight Palestinians and wounded 31 others over the past 24 hours, the Palestinian health ministry in Gaza reported. One of the eight deaths resulted from wounds sustained in previous strikes. The casualties came as rescue and medical teams worked to assist the injured across the territory.

Additional victims remained trapped under rubble in the aftermath of the strikes, according to Middle East Eye. The Palestinian health ministry did not provide specific details about the locations or the nature of the attacks that produced the casualties. Emergency services in Gaza continued response operations as the toll mounted.

title: Israeli attacks kill eight Palestinians in Gaza in 24 hours
